summary_en: Digital Garage announced EQT's acquisition vehicle raised its takeover offer for Kakaku.com to 3,700 yen per share from 3,683 yen, with the self-share acquisition price for Digital Garage adjusted to 3,008 yen from 2,994 yen. The adjustments reflect discussions between Digital Garage and the bidder to realize the transaction on EQT and Digital Garage's intended timeline.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Terms of Tender Offer for Shares of Kakaku.com Inc., an Affiliate Accounted for Using the Equity Method
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Digital Garage announced that Kamgras 1 K.K., an acquisition vehicle controlled by EQT, increased its tender offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. from 3,683 yen to 3,700 yen per share. Simultaneously, the self-share acquisition price applicable to Digital Garage's holdings was raised from 2,994 yen to 3,008 yen per share.

Digital Garage initiated a non-tendering agreement with EQT's bidder vehicle in May 2026 to take Kakaku.com private through this comprehensive transaction. The company has positioned its continued capital relationship with Kakaku.com as a strategically critical long-term investment. The price adjustments resulted from discussions between Digital Garage and the bidder to execute the transaction on the timeline planned by EQT and Digital Garage, which the company believes is desirable for Kakaku.com's medium and long-term business growth and value creation.

The pricing was structured so that Digital Garage's after-tax proceeds under the self-share acquisition mechanism, taking into account anticipated application of the deemed dividend exclusion rule under Japanese corporate tax law, are materially equivalent to what it would receive by tendering at the offer price. This ensures Digital Garage does not gain a relative advantage over other shareholders.
